data.name: UmaMahesh
data.gender_notes: UmaMahesh is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name UmaMahesh is a combination of two names - Uma and Mahesh. Uma represents the Goddess Parvati, who is the consort of Lord Shiva. Mahesh refers to Lord Shiva. Therefore, UmaMahesh can be interpreted as the union of Goddess Parvati and Lord Shiva. The name UmaMahesh carries the meaning “Goddess Uma and Lord Shiva” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose UmaMahesh usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess uma and lord shiva and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name UmaMahesh is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and is believed to bring blessings of love, fertility, and power. It is also considered an auspicious name for a baby as it represents the divine union of Shiva and Parvati.
data.etymology: UmaMahesh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess Uma and Lord Shiva.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of UmaMahesh total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
